layer12.knn_search: exhaustive squared L2, k=1, no approximate search
layer12.inference_time_scope: synchronized RGB read, transforms, features, PCA mask, configured exact kNN; excludes map rendering/export
layer12.peak_gpu_memory_scope: peak PyTorch allocated bytes: model, CUDA bank/search if enabled, and inference; excludes driver/context allocations
layer12.notes: Shared GPU performance must be measured in a coordinated slot. Metrics are a separate evaluation step.

protocol.fusion: L2 normalize each layer, concatenate with weights sqrt(0.5), then use original normalized exact nearest-neighbor pipeline
protocol.reference_matching: one shared reference patch minimizes combined distance, not independent nearest neighbors per layer
protocol.foreground_mask: unchanged official final-layer PCA mask for all variants
protocol.parameter_selection: fixed by design, no layer/weight sweep on test labels
protocol.calibration: same 20 reserved normal images, only threshold percentile 95
protocol.spatial_resolution_claim: Layer fusion does not change the patch grid
